title: Care Academy Training Note: Size Changes on Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Reservations
content:
**The rule being taught.** Where the type allows a size change before allocation, the size of a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservation can be changed to another size of the same style at the same price, at most the type's number of size changes. A size is changed only while the reservation is in status reserved or awaiting consent. The reservation keeps its reservation time, its ship-by dates and its delay history. The new size must be available for reservation. On a back-order or a launch, the customer must cancel and reserve again instead.

**Questions and answers**

*Which types allow a size change?*
The Seasonal Pre-Order and the Deposit Pre-Order, once each. The Standard Back-Order, Supplier Direct Back-Order, Launch Pre-Order and Made-to-Order Reservation allow none.

*What stays the same after a size change?*
The style, the price, the reservation time, the original and current ship-by dates, and the delay history.

*In which statuses can the size be changed?*
Reserved and awaiting consent only. An allocated reservation already has a unit set aside, and its size is not changed.

*The customer already used the one size change on a Seasonal Pre-Order. Can it be changed again?*
No. The limit is one change per reservation, and the record shows the change already used.

*The customer wants another size on a back-order or a Launch Pre-Order.*
The size is not changed on those types. The customer cancels and reserves again.

*The size wanted is not available for reservation.*
The change cannot be made, because the new size must be available for reservation.

**Checklist of conditions (all must hold)**

| Condition | Read from |
|---|---|
| Type allows a size change | Reservation type |
| Size changes already used are below the type's maximum | Reservation record |
| Status is reserved or awaiting consent | Reservation record |
| New size is of the same style and available for reservation | Item availability |
